source_constraints: Never query-labeled memory. No per-entity preassigned slot. No inference-time sign product. No external model.
candidate_description: Eight-record fixed-capacity fast associative readout; candidate learns key reliability and a 4-hidden-unit recurrent nonlinear composition mapping.
reasons_for_nonacceptance: Candidate does not beat conventional trained GRU accuracy
Candidate has more parameters than GRU, violating resource nonregression
Simulated causal paths have fixed unique path and supplied query horizon
Local development test is not independent FORGE CI qualification
Unfamiliar entity-ID blocks do not establish transfer to novel real-world causal source families
